  (S :

  (hS :

      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (S U x) = 0)
  (hC :
    ∀ (x : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Site L) (α : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannSourceAuxiliary.D →₀ ℕ),

  ∫ (U : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Links L),

        (SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannEvaluation.nilExp (4 * SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.volume L)

SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannDiracBerezin.haarPolynomial_integrable

SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannDiracBerezin.completeHaarPolynomial_eval
  (L : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Torus) (σ : ℝ)
  (S :
    SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Links L →
      SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Site L → SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannSourceAuxiliary.Polynomial)
  (hS :
    ∀ (U : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Links L) (x : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Site L),
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (S U x) = 0)
  (hC :
    ∀ (x : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Site L) (α : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannSourceAuxiliary.D →₀ ℕ),
      Continuous fun U => MvPolynomial.coeff α (S U x))
  (U : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Links L) (h : Auxiliary L → ℝ) :
  (haarPolynomialEvaluation L U h) (completeHaarPolynomial L σ S hS hC) =
    fullWeight L σ (S U) h * Matrix.det (globalMatrix L U fun a => ↑(h a))

SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannDiracBerezin.diracHaarPolynomial_eval
  (L : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Torus) (U : SKEFTHawking.ADW.FiniteGrassmannCoframe.Links L)
  (h : Auxiliary L → ℝ) :
  (haarPolynomialEvaluation L U h).mapMatrix (diracHaarPolynomial L) = globalMatrix L U fun a => ↑(h a)

MvPolynomial.pderiv.{u, v} {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommSemiring R] (i : σ) :
  Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)

MvPolynomial.pderiv_map.{u, v, u_1} {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_1} [CommSemiring S]
  {φ : R →+* S} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} :
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.map φ) f) = (MvPolynomial.map φ) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f)

MvPolynomial.pderiv_mul.{u, v} {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {i : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (f * g) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f * g + f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g

MvPolynomial.pderiv_monomial.{u, v} {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [CommSemiring R] {i : σ} :
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (s - fun₀ | i => 1)) (a * ↑(s i))

SKEFTHawking.ADW.integral_prod_hermite_mul_affine.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (α : ι → ℕ) (p : ι → Polynomial ℝ)
  (σ μ : ι → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < σ i) (v : ι → NNReal) (hv : ∀ (i : ι), ↑(v i) = σ i ^ 2) :
  (∫ (x : ι → ℝ),
      ∏ i,
        (Polynomial.aeval ((x i - μ i) / σ i)) (Polynomial.hermite (α i)) *
          Polynomial.eval (x i) (p i) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun i => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (μ i) (v i)) =
    ∏ i,
      σ i ^ α i *
        ∫ (y : ℝ), Polynomial.eval y ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[α i] (p i)) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (μ i) (v i)
